test.create(worker)
test.create(worker::/assign::target)
test.create(worker::/assign::source)
test.set_value(worker::/assign::source, 0.25)
test.create(worker::/assign::trigger)
assign.set_value(target, source)
assign.destroy(trigger)
test.destroy(worker::/assign::target)
test.destroy(worker::/assign::source)
test.destroy(worker)
